mentions.name: MedScanner
mentions.description: MedScanner is a free platform that compares medicine prices across top Indian pharmacies, helping patients—especially those with chronic health conditions—reduce their monthly medicine costs. It serves about 1K monthly users and is adding new features based on user feedback.
mentions.problem: Patients with chronic health conditions face high monthly medicine costs
mentions.audience: Patients in India, especially those with chronic health conditions looking to lower their monthly medicine costs
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently building MedScanner - a free platform to compare medicine prices in India across all top Indian pharmacy. This is specially benifical for patient with chronic health condition in decreasing their monthly medicine cost.

evidence.value: I'm currently building MedScanner - a free platform to compare medicine prices in India across all top Indian pharmacy. This is specially benifical for patient with chronic health condition in decreasing their monthly medicine cost.
